name: High Elf Domination 2
source:
After being captured, High Elf was taken to the enemy military fort where hundreds of soldiers were stationed. There, she was forced to sexually satisfy the men.

The numbers of CG in the content exceeds all the past volumes. (Animation parts CG total approximately 3000!)

Furious Full Animation, Full Voice! High Elf's Domination Story

"Hyper G" now supported!

With the movie customization (G mode), you can edit/view the content along with the past products.

Demo movie version available! 

For details, http://goebbe.sakura.ne.jp/
CV: Yunagi Oto 

She was exposed to the animalistic desire of the soldiers. Now the supreme beauty, Elf, could no longer return to her former self...

- No installation necessary for this game. (Both sales and trial versions)
- Please run the trial version for an operational test prior to the purchase.

translation:
高等精灵被俘后，被带到驻扎着数百名士兵的敌军要塞，遭到强迫，为这些男人满足性欲。

本作的CG数量超越此前所有作品。（动画部分的CG总数约为3000张！）

激烈的全动画、全语音演出！高等精灵受凌辱的故事。

现已支持“Hyper G”！

通过影片自定义功能（G模式），你可以编辑、观看本作与此前作品的内容。

现已提供演示影片版本！

详情请见：http://goebbe.sakura.ne.jp/
配音：夕凪音。

她被迫承受士兵们野兽般的欲望。如今，这位美丽无双的精灵再也无法回到从前……

- 本游戏无须安装，正式版与体验版均如此。
- 购买前，请先运行体验版，确认游戏能够正常运行。
